content: 'Aruniyaxi ti'aitame kemɨtiyeimɨkɨkai
Merikɨtsɨ Rawiri ti'aitame waɨkawa kani'ukiratsitɨkaitɨniri, pɨkaheuxɨkakai tsepa waɨkawa memika'ɨkaritɨwakai yaxeikɨa katineuhaɨtɨkaitɨni.
'Ayumieme 'iparewiwamete mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: «Xeime 'uka 'ɨimari yuxewime tepɨkuwauni para matsi'ɨwiyanikɨ, meta 'a'aurie mutihupunikɨ mɨmatsi'utixɨriyanikɨ».
Hikɨ mɨkɨ mekaniukakɨne naitsarie 'ixaheritsixi wahetsɨa 'uka mekuwautɨwetɨ witsimɨ'ane, mekanitaxeiya 'Awitsahaki Tsunemi kiekariyaritsie kiekame, mɨkɨ ti'aitame mekani'atɨirieni.
Mɨkɨ 'uka yemekɨ witsipɨtiyuxexeiyakai, ti'aitame pɨ'ɨwiyakai meta 'apɨrepiniriwakai tita mɨreuyehɨakai, peru ti'aitame mɨkɨ hatsuaku pɨka'ikumayɨa.

Merikɨtsɨ 'Aruniyaxi Rawiri nu'aya Kakiti matɨa memeyexei, kaniuyukuha'aritɨani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Ti'aitame nepayani». 'Ayumieme yuwaɨkawame kaniwarukuxeɨrieni kuyaxi. Kaxetate kuyaxa miemete meta kawayutsixi kaniwarukuxeɨrieni meta huta tewiyari heimana tamamata kuyaxi 'ihɨwemete.
'Aruniyaxi pɨtemaikɨtɨkai 'aixɨa pɨtiyuxexeiyakai yakɨ puyumaikai 'Awitsaruni 'utɨa mieme pɨhɨkɨtɨkai. Paapaya Rawiri hatsuaku pɨka'ita'imaiyaxɨ kemɨtiyurienekai 'Aruniyaxi.
'Ayumieme 'Aruniyaxi Kuhawi Tsariwiya nu'aya matɨa mekatenikuxatakaitɨni 'awie meta mawari wewiwame hamatɨa 'Awiyataxi, mɨkɨta mekaniparewieni.
'Ikɨta 'Aruniyaxi memɨka'uparewi mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai mawari wewiwame Tsaruki meta Wenahiyaxi Kuyara nu'aya, Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya, Tsimi meta Xeki meta Rawiri kuyaximama memɨkamama.

Hikɨ 'Aruniyaxi 'Enixukeri haixayari 'aurie katiniutimawa, Tsukereti 'aiyari manukatsie, mana tsikerutsixi memɨwaiyatɨka, tuurutsixi meta muxatsi mekaniwarutimawa. Yu'iwama kaniwaruta'inieni ti'aitame niwemama memɨ'iwamamatɨkaikɨ meta yunaime paratsiyuta te'uximayatamete, Kura kwieyaritsie miemete,
peru Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya pɨka'uta'ini, Wenahiyaxi meta ti'aitame kuyaximama memɨkamama, meta yu'iwa Tsarumuni pɨka'uta'ini.
'Ayumieme Natani Tsarumuni maamaya Wetitsawe, mɨpaɨ katiniuta'iwawiya: «¿Mɨpaɨ petimateri, 'Aruniyaxi Kakiti nu'aya ti'aitame mayuyeitɨaxime, tati'aitɨwame Rawiri 'atsikatimaikaku?
Xɨka pehauyuwikweitsitɨamɨkɨni meta 'aniwe Tsarumuni pehauwikweitsitɨamɨkɨni, keneneupitɨa mɨpaɨ nemɨmatitaxatɨanikɨ:

Kenemie ti'aitame Rawiri hetsɨa, mɨpaɨ ketinetahɨawi: “¿Tamɨ ne mati'uximayatsiriwame mɨpaɨ pepɨnetiuhɨritɨa, kename neniwe Tsarumuni ti'aitame 'ayanikekai 'a'utɨma? ¿Kepautɨtɨ hikɨ 'Aruniyaxi ti'aitame pɨhɨkɨ?”
Mexi 'ekɨ perekuxatani Rawiri hamatɨa neta nepautahani para neta yaxeikɨa nemɨreitahɨawekɨ».
Merikɨte Wetitsawe kaneutahani ti'aitame muyehupu. Mɨkɨri waɨkawa mɨ'ukiratsitɨkaikɨ 'Awitsahaki pi'ɨwiyakai Tsunemi kiekame.
Wetitsawe kepauka muwa munua kaniukatunumakeni hɨxiena. Hikɨ ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: —¿Ketitakɨ nematiparewieni?
Hikɨ Wetitsawe mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Neti'aitɨwame yapepɨnetiutahɨawixɨ ne mati'uximayatsiriwame, Yawé mɨ'akakaɨyari matsi'eniekaku kename neniwe Tsarumuni ti'aitame 'ayanikekai 'a'utɨma.
Peru hikɨ matsi 'Aruniyaxi pɨta ti'aitame payuyeitɨaxime, 'ekɨ 'atsipekatimaikaku yuri ti'aitame pemɨhɨkɨ.

Mɨkɨri mawari kanewewieni turutsixi, tsikerutsixi meta muxatsi kaniwarekwini yumɨireme. Hikɨ kaniwaruta'inieni yunaime ti'aitame 'aniwema, mawari wewiwame 'Awiyataxi meta Kuhawi kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame. Peru Tsarumuni pɨka'uta'ini 'aixɨa mɨmati'uximayatsirie.
Hikɨ neti'aitɨwame meta ti'aitame, yunaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi mekanita'ikwewani yapemɨtayɨnikɨ, kemɨ'ane mɨtita'aita 'a'utɨma 'a'uwenitsie mayerɨni.
Mexɨka 'ekɨ yapekatayɨwetɨ pe'umɨni, matsi kwitɨwa 'Aruniyaxi pɨtatsikwini ne meta neniwe Tsarumuni matɨa 'axateyuruwamete wahepaɨ.
Mexi 'akuxi Wetitsawe tikuxatakai ti'aitame hamatɨa, Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya kaninuani.
Ti'aitame katinetimani kepauka munua. Hikɨ Natani hɨxiena 'utihɨximakeka,
mɨpaɨ Rawiri katiniutahɨawe: —Neti'aitɨwame. ¿'Ekɨ mɨpaɨ petiuta'ai kename 'Aruniyaxi 'anukakeni 'a'utɨma?

Mɨpaɨ nekamatina'iwawiyani yanetimaitɨ mɨkɨ mawari mewewikɨ yumɨireme, turutsixi, muxatsi meta tsikerutsixi memɨwaiyatɨka. Meta yunaime 'aniwema kaniwaruta'inieni, kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete, meta mawari wewiwamete 'Awiyataxi mana mɨkɨ yunaitɨ mekatenekwaka mekane'ieka, mɨpaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ hɨxiena: “Ti'aitame 'Aruniyaxi yuheyemekɨ keti'aitani”.
Peru ne pɨkanetsi'uta'ini 'ahetsiemieme nemɨti'uximaya, yaxeikɨa mawari wewiwame Tsaruki meta Wenahiyaxi Kuyara nu'aya meta Tsarumuni pɨka'uta'ini 'aixɨa mɨmati'uximayatsirie.
¿Kamɨtsɨ 'ekɨ mɨpaɨ petiuta'ai, tame mate'uximayatsiriwamete yapekatarahɨawetɨ, kemɨ'ane 'a'utɨma 'a'uwenitsie mayerɨnikekai?
Rawiri Tsarumuni ti'aitame kemɨrayeitɨa
Merikɨtsɨ mɨpaɨ tiu'enaka, ti'aitame Rawiri mɨpaɨ katiniuta'aita: —Xekenewata'ini Wetitsawe. Mɨkɨ kaneutayani ti'aitame hɨxie kaniutakeni.
Hikɨ ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Yurikɨ Yawé hɨxie mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, mɨnetsi'uxɨnaxɨ naime 'uximatɨarika hepaɨtsita,
hikɨ nekaneye'atɨamɨkɨ kenemɨmatiutahɨawixɨ Yawé 'ixaheritsixi takakaɨyari hɨxie. Hikɨ yanepɨtiyurieni ne kenemɨmatiutahɨawixɨ, 'aniwe Tsarumuni ti'aitame payani ne'utɨma, nehetsiemieme pɨtita'aita.
Hikɨ Wetitsawe ti'aitame hɨxie 'utihɨximakeka, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Neti'aitɨwame meta ti'aitame Rawiri 'aheyemekɨ peke'ayeyurini.
'Ana Rawiri mɨpaɨ katiniuta'aita: —Xekenewata'ini mawari wewiwame Tsaruki, meta Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya metatsiere Wenahiyaxi Kuyara nu'aya. Hikɨ kepauka mɨkɨ yuhaikatɨ memu'axɨa ti'aitame hɨxie,
ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xekeniwara'inietɨ paratsiyuta memɨte'uximaya, neniwe Tsarumuni xekenanutiyetsa nemuratsie, hikɨ xekenanuwitɨki Kikuni haixayari matiniere paitɨ,

muwa mawari wewiwame Tsaruki meta Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya hatseiti witsimu'ɨa memeikawirienikɨ, 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie ti'aitame mayanikɨ. Hikɨ 'ana 'awa kuxinetayari xekenetahɨtsi meta xekenetihiwani mɨpaɨ xe'utiyuatɨ: “Ti'aitame Tsarumuni yuheyemekɨ keti'aitani”.

Hikɨ mɨpaɨ xeteheyurieme, xekenakunuitɨa Tsarumuni ne'uwenitsie mayerɨnikɨ nehetsiemieme mɨtita'aitakɨ. Karikɨ ne nekanenayexeiya mɨkɨ mɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie mɨtita'aita meta Kura kwieyaritsie.
Wenahiyaxi Kuyara nu'aya mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Mɨpaɨ ketiɨyɨni. Mɨpaɨta Yawé kehaineni ti'aitame kakaɨyarieya hɨkɨtɨtɨ.
Ti'aitame Yawé 'ahamatɨa kemɨtiuyeikakai, mɨpaɨta Tsarumuni hamatɨa ketiuyeikani, ketimariwemekɨ pemɨti'aitakai Rawiri ti'aitame, matsi waɨkawa Tsarumuni mariwemekɨ ketiuta'aita.

Tsaruki mawari wewiwame, Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya meta Wenahiyaxi Kuyara nu'aya, meta kereteutsixi, pereteutsixi, Tsarumuni mekananutiyeni Rawiri ti'aitame murayatsie, meta me'ihɨtɨ 'auriena mekaneutiwetɨkateitɨni kepauka Kikuni haixayari hepa kɨatsata memukahukai.

Meheta'axɨaka mawari wewiwame Tsaruki hatseiti 'awata mɨyema kanewatihana 'ixuriki tukiyarita Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme muyepatsieta meiyehanakai, hikɨ Tsarumuni kaniukawirieni mu'uyatsie. Meta 'awa mekaniutahɨtsieni, hikɨ yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ mekateniuhiwa: «Ti'aitame Tsarumuni yuheyemekɨ keti'aitani».
Mɨpaɨ tiuyɨku, yunaitɨ mekanekɨne 'utɨmana, pirikɨxakɨ mete'ukayuitɨwatɨ meta me'utihiwatɨ karima temawierikakɨ. Kwinimieme yemekɨ pɨtiyu'eniɨriɨkɨkai wahiwari, kwie 'ɨaritɨ puwatayuanekai.

Hikɨ 'Aruniyaxi meta yu'inierima yunaitɨ metekwatɨ mekatenitahayewarɨmekaitɨniri kepauka yuariya memu'eni. Kuhawi 'awa yuariyaya 'u'enieka, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —¿Ketitayari kuta kwinimieme metehehiwa kiekaritsie?

Kuhawi 'akuxi tikuxatakaku Kunatani kaninuani, mawari wewiwame 'Awiyataxi nu'aya. 'Aruniyaxi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Keniwataye'a. 'Ekɨ tewi 'aixɨa pemɨtiuka'iyari pepɨhɨkɨ, peuyewetse pemɨ'enierieka, xɨari niuki 'aixɨa 'anuyɨneme pepukutuane.
Hikɨ Kunatani mɨpaɨ 'Aruniyaxi katiniutahɨawe: —Neuxei mɨpaɨ pɨka'ane. Rawiri tati'aitɨwame, Tsarumuni kananukakeni mɨti'aitametɨnikɨ.
Metatsiere kaniwaruta'aitɨani Tsaruki mawari wewiwame, Natani Kakaɨyari niukameya meta Wenahiyaxi Kuyara nu'aya metatsiere kereteutsixi, pereteutsixi, Tsarumuni memanutiyenikɨ ti'aitame murayatsie.

Tsaruki Natani matɨa ti'aitame mayanikɨ hatseiti witsimu'ɨa mekaneikawirieni Kikuni paitɨ. Muwa paitɨ mekaneitsutɨani teɨteri me'utihiwatɨ temawierikakɨ meta kiekaritsie yaxeikɨa mepeyuxeɨrie. 'Ayumieme mɨkɨ hiwari kana'eniɨriɨkɨni.
Metatsiere 'ari Tsarumuni ti'aitame 'uwenieyatsie kanayerɨni,

meta paratsiyuta te'uximayatamete tati'aitɨwame Rawiri mekaneiwaɨritɨatɨwekaitɨni mɨyamɨtiuyurikɨ. Mɨpaɨ paitɨ matsi mekateneikɨhɨawekaitɨni Kakaɨyari Tsarumuni matsi waɨkawa mariweme kehayeitɨani keyuri Rawiri, meta matsi mariwemekɨ ketiuta'aita keyuri Rawiri. Hikɨ ti'aitame Rawiri mɨpaɨ rahɨawarɨwatɨ yu'utatsie 'akaitɨ kananakatutsire
hikɨ mɨpaɨ kanetayɨni: “'Aixɨa kerahɨawarɨwani Yawé 'ixaheritsixi takakaɨyari, hikɨ mɨnetsi'upitɨa nemixeiyakɨ ne'utɨma mɨtita'aita, ne'uwenitsie 'akaime”.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ mete'u'enanaka, yunaitɨ 'Aruniyaxi 'inierimama me'anuku'uka mekaneutayeixɨani waɨkawa memamatɨ.
'Aruniyaxi, waɨkawa Tsarumuni makatɨ, 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe kaneuyuta'una, mawari wewiwame 'awateyatsie katinawiyakaitɨni.

Hikɨ yapauka ti'aitame Tsarumuni mɨpaɨ pɨtiutaxatɨarie: —Ti'aitame, 'Aruniyaxi kamenimakaka, 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe mawari wewiwame 'awateyatsie katinawiyani. Mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: “Hikɨ kwitɨwa mɨpaɨ kehetayɨni ti'aitame Tsarumuni kename ne kanetsimieni ti'uximayatsiriwame”.
Hikɨ Tsarumuni mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Xɨka yuhemekɨ heitserie 'a'uyeikani, ni'atsipɨkaranuyeyani, peru xɨka tixaɨtɨ tiuyurieni 'uxa'atɨni, kanimieriemɨkɨ.
Hikɨ ti'aitame Tsarumuni katiniutanɨ'ani mɨwitɨkiemiekɨ. Kepauka 'Aruniyaxi munua, kaniutihɨximakeni ti'aitame Tsarumuni hɨxie, hikɨ mɨkɨ kanitanɨ'ani yukie mɨyemiekɨ.
